18 - K. #Alajbegovic (18 years and 361 days) is only the 2nd 18-year-old in history to score a goal wearing the #Juventus shirt in a major European competition, following G. Zigoni (18 years and 311 days, against OFK Belgrade in the Inter-Cities Fairs Cup, on October 2, 1963). Gem.[Opta Paolo]

5 - #Juventus has won its seasonal debut match in a major European competition by at least a 5 goal margin for the 7th time in its history, the 1st since its debut in the 1992/93 UEFA Cup (6-1 vs #AnorthosisFamagosta), when they lifted the trophy at the end of the tournament. Launch.[Opta Paolo]

When #Spalletti said: “#Alajbegovic creates a temporary shock, gives a powerful jolt and maximizes the play he envisions”In #JuveNEC, we saw the proof. 1 shot-1 goal, 16 passes out of 16 (100% accuracy), 2 dribbles out of 2, only 1 possession lost.If he gets more involved, he will become decisive.[Marco Baridon]
